pkgmetadata.longdescription: NanoBot is a lightweight, open-source personal AI assistant framework that connects LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) to external tools, chat platforms (Telegram, Slack, DingTalk, Discord, Matrix), and custom workflows via MCP. The web UI build is skipped at package build time; use the upstream webui/ directory with bun or npm to build it separately if needed.
